note: Static inspection of external repositories (read-only clones, commit hashes below). No external pickle was unpickled (untrusted pickles can execute code). No external model was used to produce any number in this project.

repositories.name: omarbasha19/Computer-Vision-Traffic-Sign-Recognition
repositories.classifier_in_notebook: sklearn SVC(kernel='linear', probability=True); also a Keras CNN (out of scope here)
repositories.observation: The notebook loads 'svm_model.pkl' but this file is NOT in the repository, so no pretrained model could be obtained from it.

repositories.name: ZhouJiaHuan/traffic-sign-detection
repositories.model_file: svm_hog_classification/svm_model.pkl (38,559,187 bytes) - NOT copied into this project
repositories.classifier_in_source: sklearn SVC(C=10, tol=1e-3, probability=True), Python-2 era code
repositories.observation: 7-class label space for a different traffic-sign dataset; HOG window 64x64 vs our 32x32; no GTSRB label mapping exists.

repositories.name: davidakhihiero/traffic-sign-classification
repositories.implementation: MATLAB: extractHOGFeatures (default parameters) + fitcecoc one-vs-one SVM on GTSRB
repositories.claimed_in_their_readme: SVM+HOG ~92.20% accuracy (their claim, unverified, NOT our result)
repositories.observation: MATLAB .mat model: cannot be evaluated with scikit-learn; preprocessing/split not identical to ours.

repositories.name: nakul3112/Traffic-sign-recognition
model_files: dataset.pkl (98,546,923 bytes) - described by its README as the trained SVM model; NOT copied, NOT unpickled
repositories.implementation: Python/OpenCV: cv2.HOGDescriptor() default parameters + pickled sklearn classifier, detection + classification of signs in driving video
repositories.observation: Different dataset/label scheme (template signs + driving video), default OpenCV HOG window; metadata incomplete for a fair comparison.

statement: Reference model was inspected as an external implementation, but direct numerical comparison was not performed because the original preprocessing/split/model metadata does not allow a scientifically fair comparison.
